verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents an official MCP server that gives AI models a standardized interface to its scraping, structured extraction and crawling capabilities. A first-party GitHub repo (hyperbrowserai/mcp) lists concrete tools such as scrape_webpage, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server, and documented client setup/connection steps in the evidence.
